sloka: शुभाशुभानि वाक्यानि यान्याहुः पुरवासिनः ।श्रुत्वेदानीं शुभं कुर्यां नकुर्यामशुभानि च ।। ७.४३.१० ॥
transliteration: śubhāśubhāni vākyāni yānyāhuḥ puravāsinaḥ ।śrutvedānīṁ śubhaṁ kuryāṁ nakuryāmaśubhāni ca ।। 7.43.10 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the good and bad words spoken by the city dwellers, I should now do what is good and avoid what is bad.
